Claim 2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a user interface of a subscriber device, wherein the filtered EPG information is displayed only for programs delivered by the content delivery provider to the subscriber__.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription data specific to the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber __as determined by the content delivery provider's subscription records__.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __in a format that identifies only channels accessible through the content delivery provider's service__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that excludes channels provided by the EPG provider but not by the content delivery provider__.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __derived from the content delivery provider's subscription information__.

Claim 6 (Original): The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __that is independent of and separate from a content delivery provider__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider __and the filtering being performed based on subscription information maintained exclusively by the content delivery provider__.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a user interface of a subscriber device, wherein only programs available through the content delivery provider are displayed__.

Claim 9 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription data specific to the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber __as determined by the content delivery provider's subscription records__.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __in a format that identifies only channels accessible through the content delivery provider's service__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __that excludes channels provided by the EPG provider but not by the content delivery provider__.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __derived from the content delivery provider's subscription information__.

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a user interface of a subscriber device, wherein only programs available through the content delivery provider are displayed__.
